about: The Chief pressure test question set. Every Chief fix adds its regression test here (regression: true, note with date and what broke); every feature members will ask about adds a test (source: feature). checks: tools (a|b = either), must / mustNot (case-insensitive regex), noAsk (no which-league reply). The app syncs new ids to the worker on the next run.
